proposals.title: Connector-declared evidence labels
proposals.resolution: Connector metadata may label an upstream result observed, modelled, or proxy; SELECT propagates the label without adding a parser op.

proposals.title: Positive entity union
proposals.resolution: Adopt the common positive case as list-valued SELECT.entity with deterministic union and deduplication; do not imply general intersection or difference.

proposals.title: Typed FILTER over records and source dimensions
proposals.decision_note: FILTER core accepted; promotion gated on typed connector field declarations; ships in v2.4.0 bundle

proposals.title: Partitioned GROUP
proposals.decision_note: need accepted by both reviews; keyed-result representation RFC required (v2.2.1 by:space returns scalar, not keyed Field)

proposals.title: General record-set intersection and difference
proposals.note: The positive union subset is already ALG-001; this proposal covers only semantics not supplied by list-valued SELECT.entity.

proposals.title: Unit-tagged derived arithmetic
proposals.decision_note: unit/grain/lineage result metadata + fail-closed arithmetic; v2.3.0, executor-only

proposals.title: Explicit temporal alignment and vintage
proposals.decision_note: temporal alignment contract on Series operands (scalar-window exempt); v2.3.0, executor-only

proposals.title: Epistemic CORROBORATE or VERIFY
proposals.decision_note: fails open without connector lineage metadata; evidence bar recorded in decision

proposals.title: Multi-clause completeness
proposals.note: Adopt mandatory clause completeness and upstream clause splitting; BUNDLE remains deferred until cross-clause dependencies require it.

proposals.title: Causal requests remain typed asks
proposals.resolution_candidate: Compile causal intent to a typed DataRequest unless a future claim layer carries an explicit identification design; never overload observational COMPARE or ESTIMATE.

proposals.title: Discovery-rate saturation protocol
proposals.resolution: Saturation requires coverage and breaker pressure plus three consecutive post-freeze untouched holdouts of at least 40 rows, a flat discovery curve, complete guards, and immutable checksums.

proposals.title: Family-level discovery and absorption accounting
proposals.note: H20 showed that failing-row count and semantic novelty are different axes. A family closes only after one generalized repair, positive variants, adjacent negative guards, a full-wall regression, and a new untouched-bank contact; reports publish both family and row counts.

proposals.title: Pre-contact semantic gold lint gate
proposals.note: H20 admitted two singular-winner RANK golds without k:1 and one density ambiguity. Admission should lint rank cardinality, candidate coverage, distinct operands, complete unsupported phrases, source-gap versus hole status, and requested output form before the immutable checksum.

proposals.title: Output-form-sensitive diagnostic scoring
proposals.note: H20 first contact scored 0.917 coarsely but only 18/40 under strict audit. The diagnostic scorer should distinguish Records, count, presence, density, Series, Scalar, and Ranking including k; strict canonical audit remains the release gate.

proposals.title: Connector-declared annotation-layer admissibility
proposals.note: H21 pre-contact execution showed that arbitrary ANNOTATE layers can return an Answer with absent fields. Connectors should declare field type, unit, coverage, and provider; unsupported or insufficient layers fail closed with a source-gap DataRequest.

proposals.title: Fail-closed resolver morphology
proposals.note: H21 explicit gig-work platform was falsely routed to craft workshops because work prefix-matched workshop. H23 then showed zero-overlap entity restoration rewriting cold storage to marketplace, while the legacy main-marketplace and coworking-access golds demonstrated unsafe modifier dropping. Replace uncontrolled prefix/subset equality with declared aliases or bounded morphology plus a resolver certificate.

proposals.title: Bounded endpoint-direction versus trend convention
proposals.resolution_candidate: From-to event wording such as did X go up/down denotes endpoint CHANGE; progressive or explicit trajectory wording denotes unary TREND; unresolved surfaces are rejected or carry alternative golds.

proposals.title: Same-quantity guard for temporal COMPARE orientation
proposals.resolution: Later-minus-earlier canonicalization applies only when both operands resolve to the same entity or quantity; cross-entity arithmetic preserves written order.

proposals.title: Fail-closed grain co-scoping for arithmetic
proposals.note: Contested remedy: provenance-only disclosure versus a DataRequest on incompatible grains. Not released.

proposals.title: Exact series-point selection
proposals.note: H18 showed that SELECT(time:null) cannot simultaneously mean a whole series and one latest scalar. Candidate surface is PICK or a restricted typed REDUCE.

proposals.title: Explicit source gaps are not semantic holes
proposals.resolution_candidate: Preserve explicitly requested unsupported literals and return a source-gap DataRequest; reserve holes for unresolved user meaning or references.

proposals.title: Connector-declared temporal admissibility
proposals.note: H19 showed that a current-snapshot record connector can silently accept historical time constraints and manufacture a trend or endpoint comparison. Connectors must declare time semantics and the executor must fail closed when the requested temporal evidence is unavailable.

proposals.title: Unbounded scalar change needs an interval policy
proposals.note: H19 exposed a conflict between absent-time-null series retrieval and a scalar 'how much did X change' request, which requires two endpoints. The framework must choose an explicit available-range convention or a typed interval clarification; benchmark golds must not invent two time holes ad hoc.

proposals.title: Explicit scope certificates for native-grain connectors
proposals.note: H21 showed that a wrong subnational World Bank operand could execute to the intended national value because the resolver inferred France from a geocoder parent. Native-grain routing must certify the requested scope and fail closed on implicit coarsening.

proposals.title: Recursive hole safety for every value-or-node slot
proposals.note: H22 encoded an unresolved ESTIMATE target as REGION(place='?place'). The validator inspected target as a leaf but did not walk the REGION, so the unbound placeholder reached geocoding and execution. The spec already requires every nested hole to stop execution; implementations need exhaustive value-or-node traversal tests.
required_tests: no connector call before unbound refusal

proposals.title: Declared numeric value binding for record aggregation
proposals.note: H22 showed AGGREGATE(by=space, metric=mean) falling through to row count. RELATE(distance) can declare dist_km as its value column, but general record means require an explicit typed numeric field contract rather than guessing among ids, coordinates, and annotations.
required_tests: mean never falls through to count
arbitrary numeric id is not averaged

proposals.title: Frozen IR input-type enforcement
proposals.note: H24 produced schema-valid trees that fed scalar AGGREGATE outputs into Records-only RELATE/AGGREGATE/ESTIMATE inputs and a non-REGION node into ESTIMATE.target. Validators must enforce every frozen signature before connector execution.

proposals.title: Constrained typed holes
proposals.note: H23 focus-city-in-India preserved a known country constraint only by encoding it in an opaque hole name. A typed clarification slot should retain machine-checkable region kind and fixed parent constraints without pretending the place is known.

proposals.title: Spatial candidate generation and optimization
proposals.note: H23 asked where a micro-enterprise should open to maximize foot traffic near informal markets. v2.1 can rank supplied items but cannot generate feasible locations, attach an objective, or express constraints and optimization uncertainty.

proposals.title: Bank-scoped corpus admission
proposals.note: Epoch-017 corpus audit found a superseded H10 proxy trace re-entering training because admission used global question-text membership across immutable holdouts, raw candidates, and active development banks. Admission must require exact active bank, bank-local ID, and current question text, then apply composite defect exclusions.

proposals.title: Typed deterministic answer rendering
proposals.note: H25 and the 1,196-row historical wall showed that correct typed execution can be contradicted by free-form prose: Boolean inversion, observed/modelled inversion, invented aggregates, rank-direction claims, arbitrary attrs.source promotion, and compiler errors called no-data. Common typed results and failures need deterministic renderers plus fail-closed surface-contract checks.

proposals.title: Synthesis-faithfulness saturation wall
proposals.note: Epoch 017 passed compiler/executor certification while its answer prose systematically contradicted typed results. Every saturation wall and untouched bank must therefore pass a model-free prose/evidence audit over every row; a new synthesis or audit defect retires the epoch exactly like a parser, connector, executor, or scorer change.

proposals.title: Executable pre-contact gold and source-warrant audit
proposals.note: H25 generation used scalar year strings that the connector treated as unbounded while object windows were bounded, and sparse source-census summaries were too weak to adjudicate exact operands. Before checksum freeze, admitted golds should normalize time shape, execute each operand, and record source route, table, unit, observation count, flags, and permitted DataRequest outcomes without contacting the parser under test.
required_tests: one requested point per exact-year operand

proposals.title: Upstream source outages are typed evidence gaps
proposals.note: H26's pre-contact direct-gold audit exhausted bounded Overpass retries and exposed a generic executor error. A transport outage neither proves an empty result nor invalidates a typed plan: it must return a source_unavailable DataRequest, preserve any accumulated provenance, distinguish temporary availability from connector coverage and truncation, and invite retry or a verified alternate source.

proposals.title: Tiered practical and hard saturation claims
proposals.note: For first-pass exploration across many sectors, a complete broad certification wall plus one parser-blind post-freeze bank of at least 80 rows (or two independently generated banks of at least 40), at least half adversarial and clean on every eligible first-contact gate, may support an explicitly labelled practical-saturation claim. The existing three-consecutive-bank protocol remains hard saturation for second-round LoRA, integration, deployment, or low-residual-failure claims. Any valid change still invalidates the exam, forces absorption and refreeze, and requires a new qualifying bank; the target claim must be selected before holdout contact.
required_tests: one bank at least 80 or two banks at least 40
repair forces refreeze and new exam
report distinguishes practical from hard saturation

proposals.title: Shared active-bank identity for certification consumers
proposals.note: Coverage, wall, corpus, defect registry, and freeze manifest must consume one exact active-bank authority. Filesystem discovery admitted retired pressure rows and made published counts disagree despite individually valid artifacts.
required_tests: identical bank sets across wall matrix corpus and freeze

proposals.title: Gold leaves require literal geography and entity warrant
proposals.note: H27 gold silently chose Argentina for bare Cordoba, Cebu City for bare Cebu, and train station for generic station. Fixed gold leaves must be spoken, uniquely entailed by declared scope, or represented by a typed hole; post-contact clarifications belong only in disclosed development copies.

proposals.title: Coarse and strict contracts share literal normalization
proposals.note: H27 was strictly exact but the ordinary answer contract rejected population-density against population density. Approximate contracts may omit detail but must derive separator and literal equivalence from the same canonical authority as strict audit.

proposals.title: Full-cardinality RANK canonical identity
proposals.note: RANK over N items with k=N has the same denotation as the identical full rank with k absent. Normalize this identity for equality, caching, and answer contracts while retaining provenance; k below N remains meaning-bearing.

proposals.title: Shared renderer and synthesis-audit failure contract
proposals.note: The source_unavailable renderer faithfully emitted temporarily unavailable and availability gap, but its mechanical scorer recognized neither and rejected 30 H28 responses. Typed renderers and audits must share reason-code predicates and stock fixtures.
required_tests: every stock renderer passes stock audit

proposals.title: Repair-pass typed-subexpression and hole preservation
proposals.note: H28 and epoch-021 walls showed late repairs deleting valid RELATE or ANNOTATE sources, replacing proximity with distance, and preserving invented self-relations despite explicit unresolved-role language. Repairs must declare writable slots, preserve valid typed children, and give explicit holes precedence over structural completeness.

proposals.title: Role-complete operand frames precede composition
proposals.note: H29 produced 43 strict divergences when outer operations were composed before clause- and candidate-local roles were complete. Compiler implementations must first bind spatial predicate, rank candidate, transfer donor/target, binary quantity, and epistemic-hole frames independently, then compose them without sibling attribute leakage or subtree loss. This adds no v2.1 operation or denotation.
required_tests: country qualifier is not a candidate
complete existing frame is not rebuilt

proposals.title: Explicit global reduction from spatial Field to Scalar
proposals.note: Seven independently audited H30 requests asked for a global total, global spatial mean, density ratio, or comparison of total cardinalities. Frozen v2.1 AGGREGATE by space produces Field and supplies no governed Field-to-Scalar reduction. Add an explicit typed reduction contract rather than silently treating a Field as a Scalar.

proposals.title: Explicit semantic identity for RANK candidates
proposals.note: Five clean H30 breaker patterns rank candidates sharing the same place/entity but differing by time, metric, relation, annotation layer, or composition. Frozen v2.1 derives labels from region/entity and cannot faithfully distinguish the result items. Give each candidate an explicit, question-warranted semantic identity or label with canonical provenance.

proposals.title: Separate expressiveness breakers from scored saturation exams
proposals.note: H30 precontact audit found 28 repairable question/gold warrant defects, 13 rows not faithfully expressible in frozen v2.1, and two duplicates before parser contact. Admission must preserve the raw artifact, apply only reproducible precontact repairs, score only expressible unambiguous rows, and retain non-expressible rows in a separate breaker lane for algebra evolution.
required_tests: no parser contact before immutable admission
